title: The failure branch
hook: A toy isolated request earns less and loses less when it fails. Compare both branches.

knows: basic arithmetic and the meaning of a percentage
doesNotKnow: Include a rare failure’s stipulated loss when comparing a containment cost with its avoided exposure.

misconception: Only the normal branch matters when failures are uncommon.
objective: Include a rare failure’s stipulated loss when comparing a containment cost with its avoided exposure.
